description.value: Mission Springs Brewing Company is one of BC's oldest craft brewhouses, operating since 1996 in a 10-barrel facility overlooking the Fraser River in Mission. The pub and restaurant offers its own lineup of craft beers on tap alongside a full food menu, with beer also available in growlers, cans, and kegs to take home. Three patios and a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere make it a natural gathering spot for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.
